sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant writ petition seeks quashing of the FIR dated 31.08.2023 giving rise to Case Crime No.0138 of 2023, under Sections-419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B IPC, Police Station-Bhatpar Rani,
District-Deoria.
3. The original service book has been produced by learned AGA.
The original service book does not contain any reference to the TET examination which is alleged to have been cleared by Ashutoshdhar Dubey.

The allegation in the first information report is that he was granted Abhishek Kumar Shahi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187453394/
1 appointment, though he was not qualified and that an unqualified person has been appointed and has been paid salary in connivance with the Manager.

entities.text: Abhishek Kumar Shahi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This instant petition is by the petitioner.

It has been vehemently argued that Ashutoshdhar Dubey, who was appointed was fully qualified and that it was examined by a Committee including the TET certificate and, thereafter, appointment was granted which was duly approved by the competent authority.

4. Despite a pointed query by the court, learned counsel for the petitioner has no explanation as to why in the column of service book which mentions the examination passed, there is no reference of the TET examination which has been allegedly cleared by Ashutoshdhar Dubey.
In fact, the contention of learned counsel for the petitioner, at this stage, is that the service book itself has been manipulated and is not worthy of credence.
This dispute is beyond the scope of the writ petition.
5. Prima facie, the service book supports the allegations made in the first information report, and therefore, the matter definitely requires investigation.
The allegations also contain the ingredients of a cognizable offence, therefore, also the first information report cannot be quashed.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
